description: Land Title Settlement Department - Inguruwatta, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320017
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
